changeSet.author: copilot
changeSet.sql: WITH recipe_totals AS ( SELECT ci.cocktail_id, SUM(ic.count) FILTER ( WHERE ic.unit_type = 1 AND lower(i.name) NOT LIKE '%ice%' AND lower(i.name) NOT LIKE '%лед%' ) AS liquid_volume, SUM(ic.count * CASE WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%aperol%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%апероль%' THEN 11 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%vermouth%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%вермут%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%sherry%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%херес%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%port%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%портвейн%' THEN 17 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%liqueur%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%ликер%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%ликёр%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%курасао%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%амаретто%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%фалернум%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%драм%' THEN 25 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%campari%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%кампари%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%красный биттер%' THEN 25 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%sake%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%саке%' THEN 15 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%wine%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%вино%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%шампан%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%игрист%' THEN 12 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%биттер%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%bitter%' THEN 40 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%сверхкрепкий%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%overproof%' THEN 75 WHEN lower(i.name) LIKE '%водк%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%vodka%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%джин%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%gin%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%ром%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%rum%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%текил%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%tequila%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%виски%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%whisk%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%бурбон%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%bourbon%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%бренди%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%brandy%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%коньяк%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%cognac%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%абсент%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%absinthe%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%кальвадос%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%calvados%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%мескаль%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%mezcal%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%кашас%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%cachaca%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%граппа%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%grappa%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%писко%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%pisco%' THEN 40 ELSE 25 END) FILTER ( WHERE i.alcoholic AND ic.unit_type = 1 ) AS alcohol_volume_percent FROM cocktail_ingredients ci JOIN ingredient_and_count ic ON ic.id = ci.ingredients_id JOIN ingredient i ON i.id = ic.ingredient_id GROUP BY ci.cocktail_id ) UPDATE cocktail c SET volume = CASE WHEN c.volume <= 0 AND totals.liquid_volume > 0 THEN totals.liquid_volume ELSE c.volume END, strength = CASE WHEN c.strength <= 0 AND totals.liquid_volume > 0 AND totals.alcohol_volume_percent > 0 THEN LEAST(100, GREATEST(1, ROUND(totals.alcohol_volume_percent / totals.liquid_volume)::INTEGER)) ELSE c.strength END FROM recipe_totals totals WHERE totals.cocktail_id = c.id AND ((c.volume <= 0 AND totals.liquid_volume > 0) OR (c.strength <= 0 AND totals.liquid_volume > 0 AND totals.alcohol_volume_percent > 0));
